newsitem.title: UK: Man Utd drops after European cup defeat.
newsitem.headline: Man Utd drops after European cup defeat.

text.p: Shares in Manchester United Plc dropped in early trade on Thursday after the club's European Cup semi-final defeat against Borussia Dortmund.

The stock, which on Wednesday spiked to a six-week high of 668p on hopes that the club will retain the English soccer league championship, was down 10-1/2p at 651 by 0730 GMT in thin volume of 7,832 shares.
Dortmund's 1-0 win at Old Trafford gave the German club a 2-0 win on aggregate in the lucrative competition.
Elsewhere among soccer clubs, Sunderland Plc, threatened with relegation from the premier league, was down 15p at 472-1/2.
